newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND'S BANK HANDLOWY SAYS OFFER OVERSUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: POLAND'S BANK HANDLOWY SAYS OFFER OVERSUBSCRIBED.

text.p: The public offering of Poland's Bank Handlowy SA attracted heavy demand with the retail offer three times times oversubscribed and the institutional tranche showing 17.4-fold oversubscription, the bank said on Wednesday.
Late on Tuesday the treasury set the price of Handlowy's offer at 35 zlotys, at the top of its 28-35 zloty price range.

Handlowy said in a statement that the state treasury which had originally offered 9,750,000 shares or 15 percent in the retail tranche had decided to almost double the offer by moving 9.1 million shares out of the 27,859,000-share tranche reserved for a group of selected so-called stable investors.
Handlowy said that foreign investors would take up 20 percent or 3.9 million shares out of the institutional 19.5-million-share tranche in the form of Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs).

It said individual investors placed a total of 139,766 orders with 90 percent of orders placed in the first subscription period from May 26 to June 6, when shares were offered with a higher five-percent discount.
Handlowy was offering a total of 61,750,000 shares out of its 65 million shares with the public subscription held on May 26-June 13.

It is also offering up to 4,641,000 shares to its employees at par value of four zlotys. The treasury ministry has yet to sign final agreements on the sale Handlowy shares in the long-term investor tranche.
